subject: angol
title: A cancelled train
instructionsHu: Angliában utazol, és törölték a vonatodat. Menj oda az információs pulthoz, mondd el a problémát, és tudd meg, hogyan juthatsz el a célodhoz. Minden pontot teljesíts.

situation.context: You are travelling alone from Manchester to London, where your aunt is going to meet you at the station. At Manchester Piccadilly station you see on the board that your train has been cancelled. You go to the information desk.
situation.candidateRole: You are a passenger whose train has been cancelled.
situation.examinerRole: The examiner is the assistant at the information desk.
goals: Ask when the next train to London leaves and from which platform.
Find out if your ticket is valid on that train or if you have to pay extra.
Ask where you can get something to eat while you are waiting.

followUpQuestions: I'm sorry about that. Can I see your ticket, please?
The next one leaves at a quarter to four from platform six, but it's a slower train. It arrives in London at half past six. Is that all right for you?
Is there anything else you need to know?

usefulPhrases.en: My train to London has been cancelled.
When does the next train leave?
Which platform does it leave from?
Do I have to pay extra?
Is there a café in the station?
Someone is waiting for me in London.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Hello, I hope so. I was going to take the twenty to three train to London, but the board says it's been cancelled. My aunt is meeting me at Euston, so I'm a bit worried.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: I'm sorry about that. Can I see your ticket, please?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Yes, of course. Here you are. When does the next train to London leave, and which platform does it go from?

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: The next one leaves at a quarter to four from platform six, but it's a slower train. It arrives in London at half past six. Is that all right for you?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Yes, that's fine. I'll text my aunt and tell her I'll be late. Is my ticket valid on that train, or do I have to pay extra?

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Don't worry, your ticket is valid on any train today because of the cancellation. Is there anything else you need to know?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Yes, I haven't had lunch yet. Is there anywhere I can get something to eat while I'm waiting?

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: There are a few cafés upstairs, and there's a supermarket near the main entrance.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Great, thank you very much for your help. Goodbye!

notes: Kommunikációs cél: a vizsgázó világosan elmondja a problémát, megkérdezi a következő vonat indulását és vágányát, tisztázza, érvényes-e a jegye, végül megtudja, hol ehet valamit – mind a négy szempont teljesül, és a váratlan információra (lassabb vonat) is rugalmasan reagál.
Szókincs: a vasúti utazás szavai pontosak (the board, cancelled, platform, valid, pay extra, main entrance).

Nyelvhelyesség: a meghiúsult tervet a „was going to”, a friss hírt a befejezett jelen szenvedő szerkezet (it's been cancelled), a döntést a „will” fejezi ki (I'll text my aunt), a kérdések szórendje is hibátlan.
Érdemes megtanulni: „I was going to take the twenty to three train”, „the board says it's been cancelled”, „Is my ticket valid on that train, or do I have to pay extra?”, „while I'm waiting”.
